# pass_password (Resource)

A secret in the password store: a password plus optional key-value data,
stored as one GPG-encrypted file. The password is the first line; `data` is
written as a YAML document after it, exactly like the `pass` CLI conventions:

```
<password>
---
key: value
```

Every create, update and delete is committed to the store
(`terraform-provider-pass: write <path>` / `terraform-provider-pass: delete <path>`)
and pushed to its git remote.

Creating this resource checks that `path` is not already occupied by a secret in the
store before writing. If one exists there and isn't tracked in terraform state, create
fails instead of overwriting it — import the existing secret with `terraform import`
first, or pick a different path.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pass_password" "db" {
  path     = "Utvikling/Azure/db_password"
  password = "correct-horse-battery"
  data = {
    username = "app_user"
    host     = "db.example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Secret password
- `path` (String) Full path where the pass data will be written

### Optional

- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional key-value data

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
